wrong.why: The text says Salmon begat Boaz by Rahab but does not state that Salmon and Rahab were married.

missing.why: The text explicitly says Joram begat Ozias, identified here as Jehoram and Uzziah/Azariah.
The text explicitly says Josias begat Jechonias, identified here as Josiah and Jehoiachin.

note: The begetting statements in verses 8 and 11 stand as written; intervening generations supplied by other chapters do not invalidate them.
